pages.text: ELSE runs its code block when the IF condition was false.$(br2)The ELSE line holds only the ELSE block, at the same x as its IF. It comes right after the first END, which then stands alone. The second code block ends with $(1)END IF$().
Craft a structural base and wheat, or turn an IF block into an ELSE block.
$(1)IF prime ;$(br)BEGIN$(br)  ASSIGN primes primes ⊕ candidate ⊕ " " ;$(br)END$(br)ELSE$(br)BEGIN$(br)  NOOP$(br)END IF$()
